title: OpenStax Prealgebra 2e, 4.4 Add and Subtract Fractions with Common Denominators: Model fraction addition
summary: OpenStax Prealgebra 2e, 4.4 Add and Subtract Fractions with Common Denominators: Model fraction addition
body: OpenStax Prealgebra 2e, section "4.4 Add and Subtract Fractions with Common Denominators", prints these objectives: "Model fraction addition" "Add fractions with a common denominator" "Model fraction subtraction" "Subtract fractions with a common denominator". The section text says: "Remember, quarters are really fractions of a dollar. Quarters are another way to say fourths. So the picture of the coins shows that" This card reports that page. The objectives are the book's learning statements, not a separate proof.
